A.depoimento: Ordered the construction of two spearmen in Lisbon and dispatched a single knight to capture the neutral village of Santarem.
A.plano: Keep a garrison in Lisbon to deter enemy raids. Continue building spearmen this turn; next turn switch to archers once iron accumulates. After securing Santarem, reinforce it with troops from Lisbon to prepare for the push toward Coimbra.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered the construction of two spearmen in Lisbon and dispatched forces to take Evora, Coimbra, and Badajoz. Archers will lead the assault on the spear-held villages, while spearmen target the knight garrison at Badajoz. Lisbon’s defenses remain strong with remaining troops.
A.plano: Next turn, expect to capture Evora, Coimbra, Badajoz. Garrison each with surviving troops. Continue building spearmen in Lisbon to counter knight threats. Do not divert knights from Lisbon until we secure the western flank.

A.depoimento: This turn I trained additional spearmen in Lisboa and Santemar. I sent Santemar's spear and knight to join the marching force heading for Badajoz, and dispatched spearmen to reinforce Evora and Coimbra. Our western expansion is now set for rapid conquest.
A.plano: Next turn, capture Badajoz with Santemar's knight+spear and the marching spear. Evora and Coimbra will receive spear reinforcements to prepare attacks on Faro and Porto. Keep Lisboa's knights for a future Salamanca push. Do not divert knights from Lisbon until the western flank is secure.

B.depoimento: I ordered the construction of two spearmen and two archers in Barcelona, and dispatched four spearmen to Tarragona and four archers to Girona to seize the neutral villages. If successful, our realm will grow to three holdings by turn four.
B.plano: Next turn we will occupy Tarragona and Girona, then build there and send forces toward Zaragoza and Huesca. Remember to keep a garrison at Barcelona and monitor enemy movements. Do not split forces too thin; keep enough troops to defend each village.

A.depoimento: I sent Evora's spearmen and archers to capture Faro, and Badajoz's spearmen and knight to take Sevilha. My troops are marching to reinforce Coimbra and Badajoz. Lisbon's knights remain ready for the eastern front.
A.plano: Next turn, collect resources from new villages Faro and Sevilha. Use arriving spearmen to reinforce Coimbra and Badajoz. Keep Lisbon's knights for eastward push via Salamanca. Do not split forces; focus on consolidating holdings.

B.depoimento: This turn we recruited 1 archer and 2 spearmen in Barcelona. We dispatched a spearman to Tarragona and an archer to Girona to strengthen our fronts. Meanwhile, Girona's four archers marched toward Huesca to seize the neutral village.
B.plano: Next turn we expect to capture Huesca. Build more spearmen and archers in Barcelona to prepare for assaults on Castellon and Zaragoza. Send reinforcements from Barcelona to Tarragona and Girona to boost their attacking power. Keep a strong garrison at Barcelona to defend against enemy incursions.

A.depoimento:
This turn I sent a spearman from Faro to bolster the Sevilha attack, dispatched knights toward Salamanca and spearmen toward Porto, and began building knights and spearmen in my interior villages to prepare for the next push.
My garrisons remain lightly held to maximize offensive power.
A.plano:
Next turn, anticipate Sevilha fall; reinforce with arriving troops.
Continue building knights in Lisboa and Santarem for Salamanca push.
Send remaining spearmen to Porto; keep minimal garrisons.
Do not split forces; focus on securing Porto and Salamanca.

B.depoimento: Built spearmen in each village using available wood. Sent two knights from Barcelona toward Castellon to seize the neutral village. No enemy movements observed. Strengthening infantry for future counter-attacks.
B.plano: Build spearmen in all villages to boost infantry. Send 2 knights from Barcelona to capture Castellon next turn. After securing Castellon, focus on building more spearmen to attack knight-held neutrals. Prepare to expand eastward.

A.depoimento: We ordered new knights in Lisboa, Santarem, Evora, Coimbra, Badajoz, an archer in Faro, and a spearman in Porto. Two knights were sent from Porto to take Salamanca, while Coimbra reinforced Porto with spearmen. We held back from attacking Sevilha and Vigo, waiting for better odds.
A.plano: Next turn we expect to capture Salamanca with the knights from Porto. We will garrison Salamanca with surviving troops and continue building knights in our interior villages. We must keep at least one defensive unit in each village and avoid overextending into Sevilha or Vigo until we have superior forces.

B.depoimento: This turn I ordered spearmen production in Barcelona, Tarragona, Girona and Huesca, and dispatched eight spearmen from Tarragona to take Zaragoza. Our forces march to expand eastward.
B.plano: Next turn: capture Zaragoza with the arriving spearmen. Continue building spearmen in all villages to stockpile for further offensives. Do not split forces; keep garrisons decent. Avoid attacking Teruel or Valencia until we have enough knights or spearmen.

B.depoimento: Sent main forces to Valencia, Pamplona, and Teruel, securing three new villages. Began rebuilding spearmen in home villages for future offensives.
B.plano: Next turn: reinforce captured villages, continue building spearmen, aim to take Madrid and expand toward enemy capital. Keep garrisons strong.

A.depoimento: This turn I mobilized my forces to take the western neutrals: dispatched knights from Lisboa to Toledo, spearmen from Porto to Vigo, and a mixed force from Evora to Sevilha. I also ordered new knights and spearmen to replenish my garrisons and prepare for the eastward push.
A.plano: After sending armies, ensure each village retains enough troops to defend. Build as ordered to replenish garrisons. Do not send more troops than available; hold back reserves for unexpected enemy moves.

B.depoimento: I built spearmen in all my villages to boost our numbers, ready our armies for the incoming assaults on the neutral villages, and held our lines.
B.plano: Next turn: reinforce captured villages, continue building spearmen, aim to take Valencia, Teruel, Pamplona, then move toward Madrid. Keep garrisons strong.

A.depoimento: Launched attacks on Sevilha, Cordoba, Burgos, Teruel, and Madrid using available knights and spearmen.\nBuilt replacement troops in villages with sufficient resources.\nMarched reinforcements to Sevilha to secure victory.
A.plano: Send armies to capture Sevilha, Cordoba, Burgos, Teruel, Madrid.\nBuild knights and spearmen where resources allow.\nKeep reserves in each village for defense.

B.depoimento: This turn I built a knight in Barcelona and spearmen in all other villages. I sent Castellon's knight to Teruel to soften the garrison ahead of Barcelona's arriving army.
B.plano: Next turn: expect to capture Valencia and Teruel. Reinforce those villages, continue building spearmen and knights. Prepare to attack Burgos and Madrid. Keep garrisons above 50.

A.depoimento: We captured Burgos and Madrid, expanding our control to 13 villages. Our attacks on Cordoba and Teruel were repelled by strong enemy defenses. We continue to build our army for the next eastern push.
A.plano: Consolidate Burgos and Madrid, reinforce defenses. Build spearmen and knights where resources allow. Prepare larger assaults on Cordoba and Teruel next turn. Avoid splitting forces too thinly.

A.depoimento: This turn I ordered archers to be built in all my western villages and dispatched the existing archers from Faro to Toledo and from Porto to Madrid to begin concentrating an archer army for future offensives.
A.plano: Continue building archers each turn. Send new archers to Toledo/Madrid as they arrive. Keep at least half of each village's spearmen and knights for defense. Avoid launching attacks until we have a clear archer majority.

B.depoimento: Sent spearman forces to take Madrid and Toledo, while ordering a wave of knight production in our interior villages. Our border holdings remain defended with just enough troops to hold the line.
B.plano: Continue pressing the enemy: secure Madrid and Toledo this turn, then fortify the new borders. Keep minimal garrisons to avoid overstretching. Do not divert troops to neutral villages until the enemy front is collapsed.

A.depoimento: Built archers in all villages to stockpile forces. Sent available archers from Salamanca and Toledo to reinforce the march on Madrid, aiming to seize it next turn.
A.plano: Next turn, the arriving archers will attack Madrid. After capture, garrison Madrid and prepare to assault Cordoba and Burgos. Continue building archers each turn.

B.depoimento: Ordered every knight to march to Madrid for defense, launched a spear assault on Burgos, and commanded production of new knights and spears across our realms. Ready to hold the line.
B.plano: Send all available knights to Madrid to meet the incoming enemy army. Use 2 spears from Madrid to take Burgos. Build knights and spears in all villages to replenish stocks. Avoid diverting forces to neutral Murcia or enemy Salamanca/Toledo this turn.

B.depoimento: Sent 4 spearmen and 1 knight from Valencia to take Murcia, and 8 knights from Madrid to seize Salamanca. Reinforced Madrid with 2 spearmen from Burgos. Ordered knight and spear production across the realm to rebuild our armies.
B.plano: Capture Murcia with Valencia forces and Salamanca with Madrid knights. Keep Teruel garrison, reinforce Madrid with Burgos spears and incoming archer. Build knights and spears in all villages to replenish stocks. Do not attack Toledo or Vigo this turn.

A.depoimento: This turn we ordered the construction of three archers in each of our villages to strengthen our forces. We dispatched a knight from Porto to seize Burgos, and a mixed force from Sevilha to take Cordoba. Additionally, we sent troops from Santarem to threaten Salamanca and from Evora to press on Teruel.
A.plano: Next turn we will see if Burgos and Cordoba fall; we will reinforce our border villages and continue building archers. We must not forget to keep Coimbra and Badajoz well-defended. We decided not to send additional troops from Porto to Salamanca to preserve its garrison.

B.depoimento: This turn I sent knights to take Toledo and Salamanca, spearmen to seize Teruel and Burgos, and ordered every village to produce three archers and two spearmen to strengthen our army for future battles.
B.plano: Capture Toledo, Salamanca, Teruel, Burgos this turn. Build archers and spearmen in all villages to replenish forces and prepare for next turn. Avoid attacking neutral Murcia or enemy capital due to insufficient forces.

A.depoimento:
Built archers across western holdings.
Sent Porto's force to seize Toledo and Vigo's force to take Burgos.
Reinforced Teruel with spearmen to hold the line.
A.plano:
Rebuild Porto and Vigo garrisons after attacks.
Defend Teruel against incoming enemy army.
Prepare to capture Madrid from Salamanca next turn.

A.depoimento: I launched a spearman assault on Toledo from Badajoz and Teruel, and an archer strike on Burgos from Vigo. I also sent spearmen from Porto and Santarem to bolster Salamanca's defenses. These moves aim to expand our holdings while securing our core.
A.plano: This turn: seize Toledo with spearmen from Badajoz and Teruel; seize Burgos with archers from Vigo; reinforce Salamanca with spearmen from Porto and Santarem; build replacements in Teruel, Badajoz, Vigo, Lisboa, Santarem, Coimbra, Evora, Faro, Porto, Salamanca; do not attack Madrid this turn due to insufficient archers; prepare to reinforce captured villages next turn.

B.depoimento: We unleashed Valencia's full force upon Murcia, aiming to claim the neutral village. Meanwhile, Madrid and Zaragoza marched spearmen and archers to strengthen Toledo's defenses against the looming enemy threat. Our smiths forged fresh spearmen and knights to ready our realm for the coming clashes.
B.plano: Next turn we expect to have secured Murcia and reinforced Toledo. We will monitor the enemy army approaching Toledo and prepare to defend with our bolstered garrison. We will also continue building troops in key border villages and consider probing attacks on weak enemy targets like Cordoba or Vigo, while maintaining a strong defensive line.

A.depoimento: This turn I sent Vigo's archers to seize Burgos and Teruel's spearmen and knights to seize Toledo, while building spearmen across my lands to replace losses.
A.plano: Next turn: reinforce Burgos and Toledo with troops from Salamanca, Cordoba, and Badajoz; watch for enemy armies arriving at Toledo; build defenders in border villages; avoid overextending forces.

A.depoimento:
This turn I ordered attacks on Madrid and Murcia.
I reinforced Burgos for a future Pamplona strike and built up spear and archer reserves.
My forces march to seize the heart of enemy territory.
A.plano:
Next turn:
- Reinforce Madrid with troops from Salamanca.
- Reinforce Murcia with troops from Cordoba.
- Send archers from Porto to Vigo for future Pamplona attack.
- Keep garrisons in border villages; do not attack Toledo yet.

A.depoimento: This turn we marshaled our forces: Badajoz sent nine archers to seize Toledo, Madrid launched six archers against Zaragoza, and Burgos committed all its troops to take Pamplona. We also began training new archers in key villages to secure our gains.
A.plano: Next turn: garrison newly captured Toledo, Zaragoza, Pamplona with surviving troops; reinforce Madrid and Burgos with new archers; prepare Teruel and Murcia for attack on Valencia; avoid further attacks on Toledo.

B.depoimento: Built twelve knights across our villages, sent two knight squads to seize Zaragoza and Teruel, and reinforced Valencia with four spears to strengthen its defense.
B.plano: Next turn: verify capture of Zaragoza and Teruel; continue knight production; reinforce Valencia and other border villages; stay alert for enemy counterattacks.

B.depoimento: This turn I sent knight-heavy forces to take Teruel, Madrid, and Pamplona, leaving minimal garrisons. I also ordered new knights, archers, and spearmen across my realms to replenish and prepare for further expansion.
B.plano: Next turn: verify captures of Teruel, Madrid, Pamplona; rebuild garrisons; continue knight production in Valencia and Huesca; reinforce Valencia against Murcia; watch for enemy builds.

A.depoimento:
Ordered a knight to be built in each village to strengthen our defenses.
Sent Salamanca's full garrison to take Madrid and Toledo's archers to capture Teruel.
Expecting swift victories that will expand our control to 16 villages.
A.plano:
Send Salamanca's troops to Madrid and Toledo's archers to Teruel.
Build a knight in every village to reinforce garrisons.
Do not launch attacks on Valencia until we have secured the northern front.
Keep at least five troops in each border village after movements.

A.depoimento: I marched troops to the northern borders and strengthened garrisons, readying for the imminent capture of Zaragoza and the upcoming assault on Teruel.
A.plano: Send 6 spearmen from Madrid to Zaragoza; send 4 spearmen from Badajoz and 1 from Cordoba to Toledo; build 1 spear in Toledo, 4 in Badajoz, 1 in Cordoba, 6 in Madrid, 4 in Burgos. Keep at least 5 troops in each border village after movements. Do not attack Valencia yet.

B.depoimento: Launched assaults on Murcia, Toledo, and Burgos with spear, archer, and knight forces. Began mass production of knights and support troops across our holdings. Strengthening our position for the push toward the enemy capital.
B.plano: Capture Murcia, Toledo, Burgos this turn. Build knights and archers in all villages to reinforce. Prepare to attack Madrid next turn with accumulated forces. Monitor enemy movements for counterattacks.

A.depoimento: We launched a triple assault: Toledo's spearmen and knight stormed Teruel, Cordoba's archers overwhelmed Murcia, and Madrid's mixed force broke Zaragoza's defenses. Simultaneously, we ordered a massive spearman buildup across our realms to replenish our armies.
A.plano: This turn: attack Teruel with Toledo forces, Murcia with Cordoba, Zaragoza with Madrid. Build spears in all villages to replenish garrisons. Do not attack Pamplona or Valencia yet. Next turn, reinforce Toledo and Madrid, prepare to take Valencia from Toledo and Pamplona from Burgos.

B.depoimento: Statement: Led a knight charge from Pamplona to capture Burgos, bolstered our northern defenses with fresh spears, and began massing knights in the south for the next push.
B.plano: Plan: Secure Burgos with Pamplona's knights; reinforce Zaragoza and Teruel with spears for defense; produce knights in Barcelona, Teruel, Murcia for future offensives; hold Pamplona with remaining troops and new archer; avoid premature attacks on Madrid, Toledo, Cordoba until forces are ready.

A.depoimento: Marched Zaragoza's forces to Teruel and secured the village after a hard fight. Ordered spear production across our lands to replenish garrisons and prepare for upcoming assaults on Murcia and Pamplona. Held the line elsewhere, awaiting next turn's advances.
A.plano: Next turn, reinforce Teruel with fresh spears from Toledo and Zaragoza. Launch attacks on Murcia from Cordoba and on Pamplona from Burgos, using spear-heavy armies to exploit counter advantages. Hold all newly taken villages and prepare to push toward Valencia.

B.depoimento: We assaulted Zaragoza with Barcelona's veterans, sent reinforcements to our weak border towns, and ordered new archers to strengthen our forces.
B.plano: Plan: Capture Zaragoza, reinforce Teruel/Murcia/Pamplona, boost archer production, hold interior villages, prepare for next turn's defense and further expansion.

A.depoimento: This turn I sent spears from Toledo and Zaragoza to Teruel, spears from Cordoba and Sevilla to Murcia, and a knight-heavy force from Burgos, Sevilla and Cordoba to Pamplona. If successful, we will control 18 villages and edge closer to victory.
A.plano: Next turn, reinforce Teruel, Murcia, Pamplona with arriving troops and any surplus; hold them against expected enemy knight reinforcements. Prepare to advance on Valencia once 18 villages are held for two turns. Do not divert forces elsewhere unless a village is threatened.

B.depoimento: Launched four archer waves at Zaragoza and Teruel, built archers everywhere, and strengthened our borders while leaving interior villages lightly held.
B.plano: Send archer waves to Zaragoza and Teruel; reinforce Teruel with archers; build archers in all villages; keep interior villages empty if safe; prepare for next turn's defense.

A.depoimento: We reinforced our forward positions at Toledo and Cordoba with troops from Badajoz and Sevilha, and stocked Madrid and Burgos with forces from Salamanca and Vigo. Simultaneously, we began constructing knights in thirteen villages to build a powerful mobile reserve. These moves set the stage for an assault on Teruel and Murcia in two turns.
A.plano: Next turn, reinforce Toledo, Cordoba, Madrid, Burgos with any surplus and continue building knights. Prepare to attack Teruel and Murcia from Toledo and Cordoba the following turn. Do not divert forces from the main fronts unless a village is under imminent threat.

B.depoimento: I built archers in all my villages, dispatched reinforcement waves from interior towns to the border, and prepared garrisons for the enemy armies marching toward Teruel, Murcia, and Pamplona. I retained spearmen for local defense while using archers and knights to arrive in time.
B.plano: Send archer and knight reinforcements to Zaragoza, Teruel, Murcia, and Pamplona to meet incoming enemy armies. Build archers in every village to boost future defense. Keep at least 3-5 troops in each interior village for local security. Avoid sending spearmen on long routes; rely on fast units for timely arrival.
